highlights: The Privacy Policy link in Settings → App Info opened a page that did not exist. It now opens the policy.

Recent searches on the Inspect tab are easier to use. The Clear button was about 16pt tall, well under the 44pt minimum, so it was easy to miss; it now has a full-size tap target. Each recent domain also announces as "Look up example.com" to VoiceOver rather than reading out the bare hostname.
